## 2. Actual old cycles, uniform source counts and readout bins

For the bottom rectangular divisor graph G of 2^a 3^b, a,b>=1, let
V=(a+1)(b+1), E=a(b+1)+b(a+1), F=ab. Thus V-E+F=1.

The old three layers G,5G,7G with the 5/7 vertical edges have3V vertices and3E+2V edges. They are connected. Their binary cycle dimension is

    (3E+2V)-3V+1 = 2E+F.                              (1)

Choose a bottom spanning tree and all2V vertical edges. This has3V-1 edges and is a spanning tree of the old three-layer graph. After these tree-edge signs are fixed, the F remaining bottom horizontal signs and the E signs on each outer horizontal layer may be chosen independently. Equivalently the F bottom-face signs X_f and the2E side-face signs S5_e,S7_e are independent cycle coordinates. Rectangular plaquettes give a basis for the F bottom cycles.

Use exactly C27's coordinates

    Y_e=S5_e*S7_e  (E target coordinates),
    Y_f=X5_f      (F target coordinates),
    Z_e=S5_e      (E reference coordinates).

They are invertible coordinates because

    S5_e=Z_e, S7_e=Y_e Z_e,
    X_f=Y_f*product_boundary(f) Z_e,
    X5_f=Y_f, X7_f=Y_f*product_boundary(f) Y_e.          (2)

Consequently Y in {+1,-1}^n, n=E+F, and Z in {+1,-1}^E range independently over their FULL alphabets. Every full cycle assignment has exactly2^(3V-1) old edge-sign preimages: the tree signs are free and the non-tree signs are determined. This also follows by subtracting the2E+F cycle constraints from the3E+2V old edges. Thus uniform old edge weights induce uniform(Y,Z), with no unequal multiplicity hidden in later normalizations. Disabled added-face factors give no dependence on these old coordinates; nothing here discards an occupied old node or substitutes a different divisor graph.

Let H be any m-by-E matrix over F2. Write z_e=(-1)^x_e and define the observed reference

    T_H(z)_j=product_e z_e^(H_je)=(-1)^((Hx)_j).        (3)

Each row is a product of original5-side closed-cycle characters; in old edge variables it is their binary symmetric-difference cycle. It need not be connected or a simple loop. This is mathematical source provenance, not a claim about an apparatus measuring it.

Let r=rank_F2(H). The actual reference alphabet is im(H), expressed as signs, of size2^r. Every nonempty fiber contains2^(E-r) values of Z. Rows may be redundant or zero. Bins outside im(H) have structural probability0 and must not be declared strictly positive or included in odds divisions.

The finite pairing fact used repeatedly is:

    the coordinate character z_e is determined by T_H
        iff its unit row epsilon_e belongs to row_F2(H). (4)

Indeed epsilon_e=s^T H gives z_e=product_j T_j^(s_j). Conversely, if epsilon_e is not in row(H)=(ker H)^perp, some k in ker H has k_e=1. Translation x->x+k preserves every readout and flips z_e. Thus z_e is balanced on every fiber:

    sum_(z:T_H(z)=t) z_e=0,  t in im(H).               (5)

The row-space identity here is ordinary finite linear algebra, not a numerical rank computation.

## 3. Statement A: complete rank is necessary and sufficient for universal direct conditioning

Define the property carefully. We ask whether conditioning DIRECTLY on the available T_H, without a calibrated-channel inversion, removes control-synchronous factors that depend only on the true original reference Z, uniformly over the old positive face-weight family allowed in C27. The intended conditional comparison should leave only the prescribed target factor K_B(y)/K_A(y), up to a y-independent normalization.

This is a universal source-safety statement. It is NOT a claim that every particular target is unidentifiable whenever H has deficient rank. Section5 gives the exact weaker criterion for one particular local family.

If r=E, T_H determines the full true Z. For the conditional model

    P_u(y,z)=Q(y,z)L_u(z)K_u(y)/N_u,

strict positivity on the true alphabet implies, for t=T_H(z),

    P_u(y|t)=Q(y,z)K_u(y)/sum_x Q(x,z)K_u(x).

L_u(z) cancels exactly. Thus full rank is sufficient, even for arbitrary strictly positive Q and L in this equation; no statistical independence of Y and Z is required.

For necessity it is not enough to invent an arbitrary Q. The next section pays a counterexample using only two literal OLD face factors of the actual graph whenever rank is deficient. Therefore

    universal direct Z-only-background elimination
        holds for T_H iff rank(H)=E.                   (6)

In particular at least E independent binary character readouts are necessary for this UNIVERSAL property; m>=E alone is insufficient without rankE. It is a statement about the specified deterministic-character category, not arbitrary noisy channels, arbitrary nonlinear sensors, bit costs or physical accessibility.

For210 the old bottom square has E=4,F=1,n=5: universal safety in this category needs4 independent reference characters. For1260 the bottom2-by-2 rectangle has E=12,F=4,n=16 and needs rank12. No state enumeration or empirical calibration was performed for either count.

## 4. Rank-deficient counterexample entirely in the original face family

Suppose r<E. Choose a nonzero k in ker H and an edge e with k_e=1. Equation(5) holds for z_e in EVERY actual reference fiber.

Turn on only the original7-side face factor and the original5-side synchronous factor

    Q_b(y,z)=1+b y_e z_e,    L_a(z)=1+a z_e,
    0<a,b<1.                                           (7)

These are literal graph factors because y_e z_e=S7_e and z_e=S5_e in(2). All other old factors may be1, and target mixed terms are disabled, K=1. This is the closed/disabled-term local setting explicitly admitted in the input; it does not purport to lie in a domain demanding every mixed parameter be nonzero. Each individual factor in(7), and hence every full state weight, is strictly positive.

The normalized full distribution on(Y,Z) is

    P_a(y,z)=(1+a z_e)(1+b y_e z_e)/2^(n+E).             (8)

The denominator is exact: expanding gives1+a z_e+b y_e z_e+ab y_e; all three nonconstant characters sum to0 over the complete independent alphabets.

Using(5), compression gives for EVERY y and t in im(H)

    P_a(y,t)
      =2^-(n+r) (1+ab y_e).                             (9)

This includes all other target coordinates; they remain uniform. The reference marginal is exactly P_a(t)=2^-r, independent of a. Given any t,

    P_a(Y_e=+1|t)=(1+ab)/2.

Take b=1/2 and change only the old5-side parameter from a_A=1/2 to a_B=4/5. The target factor K has not changed at all, yet the conditional probability changes from5/8 to7/10. Both are positive, and every reference group displays the same spurious target contrast. The A-to-B positive-versus-negative odds factor is7/5 rather than1.

Thus all groups can agree with each other, all rectangular group-consistency tests can pass, and the observed reference marginal can stay unchanged, while the compressed conditioning fails to remove the permitted Z-only change. The witness is an actual old5/7-face family, not a source-external target-specific leakage or an arbitrary-Q reparameterization. It proves necessity in(6).

Multiplying by any fixed positive target function would still leave the extra(1+a b y_e) factor after compression. We do not need that enlargement: the explicit disabled-target witness already establishes failure in the stated source family.

## 5. Statement B: exact criterion for the one supplied local target

Now RESTRICT to the explicit C27 section4 local bridge at the bottom edge e0=1--2. No claim about an arbitrary independently tunable mixed bridge at every edge is imported from unread C21.

Put y=Y_e0, z=Z_e0, and use precisely

    P_u(y,z) =
      (1+a_u z)(1+b yz)(1+w_u y) /
      [4(1+a_u b w_u)],
    w_A=w, w_B=cw, c=1/16,
    0<a_A,a_B,b,w<1.                                   (10)

All other face/mixed factors are disabled. In the full(Y,Z) coordinate model, the other n-1 target and E-1 reference coordinates are uniform. The full-state normalization is2^(n+E)(1+a_u b w_u), since the product in(10) expands to constant1+a_u b w_u and characters whose total sums vanish.

Here, with H known and complete exact joint data(Y,T_H) supplied, the target w is identifiable over this nuisance-parameter family iff

    epsilon_e0 belongs to row(H).                      (11)

This is deliberately a LOCAL-family theorem. If other old couplings or synchronous factors are enabled, observing z_e0 alone need not remove them. That broader problem is covered neither by(11) nor by an unproved independence claim.

For sufficiency in(11), express z_e0 as a product of T bits using(4). Summing the observed joint over the other target/reference-readout components gives the exact two-sign joint distribution in(10). At either fixed z the within-control odds equal

    O_u(z) = P_u(+1,z)/P_u(-1,z)
           =[(1+bz)/(1-bz)] [(1+w_u)/(1-w_u)].

The factor a_u cancels within each conditional odds, and b cancels between the two controls. Therefore

    J=O_A(z)/O_B(z)
      =(1+w)(1-cw)/[(1-w)(1+cw)].                      (12)

For0<w<1 and0<c<1,

    dJ/dw =
      2(1-c)(1+cw^2)/[(1-w)(1+cw)]^2 >0.

The same J is obtained at both z values. It determines w uniquely, equivalently as the unique root in(0,1) of

    c(J-1)w^2+(1-c)(J+1)w-(J-1)=0.                    (13)

No full inverse for13 target parameters, C23 spectral theorem or empirical fitting is used.

For necessity, suppose epsilon_e0 is not in row(H). Equation(5) balances z on each readout fiber. Expanding and summing the ACTUAL factors in(10) yields for the FULL target vector y_all and every admissible t

    P_u(y_all,t)=2^-(n+r)(1+m_u Y_e0),
    m_u=(w_u+a_u b)/(1+a_u b w_u).                     (14)

Thus this is a statement about all observed target/readout bins, not just selected moments. No hidden target components carry extra information in the restricted family.

Choose the same b=1/2,c=1/16 in both candidate models. The two different positive parameter triples(w,a_A,a_B) are

    first:  (1/16, 1/2,     4/5);
    second: (1/32, 115/206, 526844/655867).              (15)

Both give EXACTLY

    m_A=4/13,    m_B=517/1282.

For direct verification solve(14) at a specified w:

    a_A=2(m_A-w)/(1-m_A w),
    a_B=2(m_B-cw)/(1-m_B cw).

At w=1/16 these give1/2,4/5; at w=1/32 they give115/206 and526844/655867. Every displayed numerator and denominator is positive and each numerator is strictly below its denominator. All w_u are in(0,1). Thus every individual original factor is positive and no broader Q is substituted.

By(14), both models have identical COMPLETE(Y,T_H) distributions in both controls, for every admissible bin, but their target w differs. This proves necessity in(11), including the possibility of examining all reference groups jointly.

Consequently a single correct reference character can suffice for this local family, while universally safe conditioning over the full allowed old background family needs the complete E-dimensional reference space. These are different quantifiers, not contradictory bounds.

## 6. Attached known-BSC diagnostic: completed standard interface

This is retained as an attached previously closed COMPOSE calculation, not a new file, paper or independent third theorem project.

For the two signs in(10), suppose an additional KNOWN common classical binary symmetric channel is part of the observation contract:

    hatP_u(y,z')=sum_z C_eta(z'|z)P_u(y,z),
    C_eta=same-sign1-eta / opposite-sign eta,
    0<=eta<=1.

It depends only on the true z and is conditionally independent of y and the control. Its physical calibration is NOT given by the graph or by the name reference.

If rho=1-2eta is nonzero, the exact inversion is

    P_u(y,z)=[(1-eta)hatP_u(y,z)
                    -eta hatP_u(y,-z)]/rho.

The model promises that the recovered distribution is strictly positive. Arbitrary data giving a negative inverse cannot be declared model-valid by this formula. Equations(12)-(13) then recover w uniquely. Eta=0 and eta=1 are included; the latter is a known deterministic sign flip, not information destruction.

At eta=1/2, hatP_u(y,z')=P_u(y)/2, and(15) supplies the same explicit positive-source ambiguity. This is not an assertion about unknown eta or about all noisy channels. Near1/2, inversion amplifies errors; exact identifiability does not establish a stability certificate or physical robustness.

Unlike this known invertible noisy channel, T_H in sections2-5 is an EXACT deterministic character compression. StatementA concerns direct conditioning on those characters. It is not a prohibition on calibrated deconvolution of a different, injective observation law.
